findings.title: NetworkPolicy blocks the pod's DNS lookups
findings.cause: container web exits because it cannot resolve db: NetworkPolicy egress-db-and-dns allows port 53 only to pods matching k8s-app=kube-dns, and a podSelector with no namespaceSelector picks pods of namespace kd-networkpolicy-dns-pod-selector alone, while cluster DNS runs in kube-system, so no DNS lookup gets out; its log says: "wget: bad address 'db'"; Deployment web has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
NetworkPolicy egress-db-and-dns allows port 53 only to pods matching k8s-app=kube-dns, with no namespaceSelector
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy egress-db-and-dns -n kd-networkpolicy-dns-pod-selector -o jsonpath='{.spec.egress}'

findings.fix: Add namespaceSelector {matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system}} to that peer of egress-db-and-dns, in the same entry as its podSelector, so it picks the DNS pods in kube-system.
